title: Literature-scan test queue (reports/Trading strategy paper scan.md)
registered: 2026-10-15, before any of these were run and before the Binance/Dukascopy/Databento data arrived

fills_costs.Dukascopy: next 1-min bar bid/ask, quoted spread; stress 1.5x
fills_costs.Binance: next 1-min bar, 5 bp/side taker; stress 10 bp; funding applied at 00/08/16 UTC

protocol.sizing: vol target 10%/yr per sleeve, hard stop capping a day at 1% of equity
protocol.pass: net Sharpe >= 0.8 test and >= 0.5 holdout; Harvey-Liu adjusted t >= 2.5; worst day >= -1.5% at target vol; correlation with C* <= 0.2, also on C*'s 20 worst days
protocol.variants: one frozen rule + at most two named robustness variants; anything else counts toward the trial total
protocol.lookups_before_run: exact FX fix windows and ECB fix time from the Krohn, Mueller & Whelan (JF 2024) replication package; noise-area band/leverage parameters from Zarattini et al. 2024

C1.rule: ES: if the RTH close (16:00 ET) is below the prior RTH close, buy at 02:00 ET and exit at 03:30 ET. Otherwise flat.

C2.rule: NQ and ES: band = today's RTH open × (1 ± mean of \|close/open − 1\| at the same minute over 14 days). Check at :00/:30. Long above the upper band, short below the lower band. Trailing stop = max(band, VWAP) for longs and min(band, VWAP) for shorts. Flat at 15:59 ET. Report 2024-2026 separately.
C2.variant: Trade only when VIX or 20-day realised vol is above its 1-year median

C3.rule: CL: on EIA days, take the sign of the 10:30-11:00 ET return and hold that direction 14:00-14:30 ET. On other days, take the sign of the prior 14:30 settle → 09:30 ET return and hold over the same window.

C4.rule: GC, SI, CL, 6E, 6J, ZN: signal = settle(t-1) → settle(t) − 30 min. Trade its sign into the settlement only if \|signal\| > 1 × trailing 60-day σ of the signal. Equal risk.

C5.rule: NQ: the first 5-minute RTH bar sets direction. Enter at bar 2's open. Stop at the opposite side of bar 1, target 10R or 15:59 ET. Risk 0.5% per trade.

D1.rule: Equal-weight basket of EUR, GBP, JPY, AUD, CHF, CAD and NZD vs USD. Long USD from 2h before to the WMR 16:00 London fix, then short USD from the fix to +3h. Same for the Tokyo 09:55 JST fix. DST-aware. Exact windows are taken from the Krohn et al. replication package before any run.
D1.variant: Add the ECB reference-rate fix (time from the replication package)

D2.rule: XAUUSD: long 23:00-07:00 UTC, short 07:00-16:00 UTC, otherwise flat. Report 2013-02/2015 and 03/2015-2026 separately.

D3.rule: Apply the C2 rule on DAX, FTSE 100 and Nikkei 225 CFDs with each index's cash open/close, plus US100 as a control.

D4.rule: Overlay on D1: on the last business day, if the S&P 500 month-to-date return exceeds that of an equal-weighted STOXX 600/FTSE/Nikkei basket, short USD from 13:00 to 16:00 London. Reverse the trade if the S&P lagged.

B1.rule: BTC and ETH: apply the C2 rule with session open 00:00 UTC, 14-day same-minute band, checks at :00/:30, VWAP trailing stop and flat at 23:59 UTC. Taker cost 5 bp/side. Separate Sunday 23:00 UTC-Monday 23:00 UTC P&L.

B2.rule: BTC: long 21:00-23:00 UTC, short 01:00-05:00 UTC (equal notional), taker fills.
B2.variant: Long 20:00 → 13:30 UTC, short 13:30 → 20:00 on NYSE days

B3.rule: 20 perps, point-in-time listing: weekly (Monday 00:00 UTC) cross-sectional elastic-net combination of 1/5/20/60/120-day MA price and volume ratios, trained expanding-window on data to May 2022 and frozen. Rank-weighted long-short, max 15% per name, beta-neutral to BTC.

B4.rule: Per coin: if the 1h return < -3σ (30-day hourly σ), the 1h OI change < -5%, and 1h volume > the 95th percentile, go long at the next 5-minute bar. Stop at the cascade low − 1 ATR, exit at 12h. Mirror for squeezes.

B5.rule: BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE, ADA: take the sign of (2·takerBuy − vol)/vol in the 00:00 UTC opening minute and hold 8h. Data from November 2024 onward only.

B6.rule: Overlay on the existing trend book: halve exposure when both the 30-day z-score of the premium index and the z-score of the 7-day OI change exceed the 95th percentile, and restore at the 80th. Judge on max drawdown and Calmar, not Sharpe.
